BundleInfo.name: ChimeraX-CorrectRotamer
BundleInfo.Author: Genki Terashi
BundleInfo.Synopsis: Density and local-MDFF correction of ISOLDE rotamer outliers
BundleInfo.Description: Enumerates ISOLDE canonical rotamers for existing outliers, selects valid candidates using side-chain heavy-atom map density, and optionally performs explicit probability-ordered local ISOLDE MDFF trials with a restrained backbone. The density-only workflow never starts ISOLDE.

Classifiers.ChimeraXClassifier: ChimeraX :: Tool :: Correct Rotamers :: Validation :: Density-guided rotamer correction
ChimeraX :: Command :: correctrotamers :: Validation :: Correct ISOLDE rotamer outliers using map density
ChimeraX :: Command :: correctrotamers mdff :: Validation :: Optimize rotamer outliers using local ISOLDE MDFF
